title: Chapter 1327 - 11: Another Bout With The Demon God
content:
Chapter 1327 - 11: Another Bout With The Demon God

Chapter 1327: Chapter 11: Another Bout with the Demon God

"The third level of the Chaotic Taiji Dao!"

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. After three thousand years of secluded cultivation with no distractions, he finally elevated the Chaotic Taiji Dao to perfection.

Within the Chaos Void, the limit of evolutionary power of Chaos is the Second Layer. Only in the first Source World are the rules and principles easier to comprehend, allowing for the third level.

And the third level is already the upper limit of the evolutionary power of Chaos.

Beyond that, it involves the thirteenth level, requiring the essence of time beings to continue advancing.

"Faster than expected," Lin Yuan thought with considerable satisfaction.

In many future timelines he observed, even with the Yin Yang Twin Flowers, reaching the third level required several thousand years of cultivation.

Here, several thousand years range from three thousand to five thousand years.

Reaching it in three thousand years is evidently considered fast.

"Now it’s truly my limit, likely the limit at the twelfth level as well."

Lin Yuan thought, having already mastered the sixth level of the "Infinite Void," with his three true bodies having fully developed the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

In addition to his own evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao reaching the third level.

Lin Yuan was convinced he had reached a state of ultimate progression.

Phew.

Images of thirteenth-level legacies appeared in Lin Yuan’s mind.

All came from the Chaos Void, the first Source World, and the time beings of the second Source World.

"These legacies..."

Lin Yuan carefully reviewed them. He had already comprehended all the thirteenth-level legacies, and there was no need to cultivate them.

At Lin Yuan’s current level, even the thirteenth-level legacies offer very limited enhancement.

A Great Saint mastering a thirteenth-level legacy would gain the strength of an Invincible Great Saint, causing their power to surge significantly.

However, when Lin Yuan mastered a thirteenth-level legacy, it was merely another means in combat, with minimal impact on his overall power.

Lin Yuan’s study of these thirteenth-level legacies was primarily to appreciate the paths taken by various time beings and incorporate suitable elements into the Martial Arts System.

The Martial Tao inherently encompasses myriad paths, theoretically possessing countless branches, and Lin Yuan was ambitious in its establishment.

Currently, the Martial Tao was widely spread in the Chaos Void, the two Source Worlds, and various lower-dimensional spaces, indeed influenced by Lin Yuan himself.

But without a doubt, the Martial Tao is also extremely suitable for cultivation and holds great potential.

Only in this way can it be fully promoted; without Lin Yuan’s influence, if the Martial Tao itself was unsuitable for cultivation, countless cultivators would reject it.

"I suppose my strength is somewhat superior to ordinary time beings?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself, now using time beings as a standard for his measure.

But he wasn’t very clear at what exact level he stood.

Lin Yuan could observe future timelines to see himself in combat with other time beings.

Yet, within the Chaos Void, even if time beings from the two Source Worlds clashed with him, they wouldn’t use their full strength.

And if the timeline were extended by several thousand or tens of thousands of years,

it wouldn’t accurately measure Lin Yuan’s true strength then.

For other time beings, several thousand or tens of thousands of years is but an instant.

There would be no change in strength.

But with Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed, whether it be several thousand or tens of thousands of years, or even just a few hundred or a thousand years,

his strength would grow substantially.

Estimating based on normal time beings is entirely unfeasible.

One must know, from Lin Yuan becoming an evolver until now, how much time has truly passed.

Not even a hundred thousand years have passed.

And for a hundred thousand years... not to mention time beings, even ninth or tenth level beings resembling ants perceive it as a mere blink.

"Perhaps I could spar with the Demon God from the second Source World?"

Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

The Demon God is not a normal time being.

He is the Black Demon body of the Lord of Heaven Light, lacking spiritual will, engaging Lin Yuan without concern for future timelines.

Because the Demon God doesn’t consider future timelines and acts purely on instinct.

Yet he possesses absolute strength of a time being.

Such entities as the Lord of Heaven Light, even the weakest Black Demon body lacks spiritual will, and can confront thirteenth-level time beings head-on.

"Demon God."

Lin Yuan decided.

He had only fought the Demon God once, just before he opened the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

At that time, Lin Yuan and the Demon God were neck and neck, employing every means, yet unable to overcome the Demon God.

In the end, the Demon God instinctively realized that he could not defeat Lin Yuan temporarily, so he voluntarily withdrew.

Compared to the time when Lin Yuan had just opened the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World, his strength has soared tremendously.

...

The second Source World.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged on a hill, with Demonic Qi in the surrounding large area voluntarily retreating.

"Demon God?"

Lin Yuan stood up proactively.

Since that battle, the Demon God realized he was not easily provoked and stopped bothering about the outer ’magic’, instead focusing entirely on suppressing the Source World consciousness.

Meanwhile, endless Demonic Qi was also corroding the Source World itself, cooperating inside and out with the Demon God to fully suppress the Source World.

Therefore.

To force the Demon God to appear, there was no need to strike him directly. One only needed to swiftly erode the Demonic Qi permeating between heaven and earth.

When the Demonic Qi thins enough, giving the Source World itself breathing space, it naturally nourishes the world consciousness, increasing its strength, making the Demon God’s instinctual suppression of the Source World consciousness increasingly difficult.
